purpose: One fresh UK60 attempt using the verified free-tier gemini-3.5-flash-lite in the same project with billing disabled; no paid model fallback.
execution: Create once and run preparation once in an isolated one-shot container. Use the same project credential and verify billing remains disabled. Allow at most one delayed retry only for an explicit Gemini 503 UNAVAILABLE; never retry a timeout or ambiguous result. If prepared and disk gates pass, use the previously approved single Google TTS synthesis, then one alignment, render, and QA step each.
stop_conditions: A timeout, unknown/ambiguous provider result, or second Gemini 503
Any provider call becomes unknown, ambiguous, failed, or exceeds the durable budget
Preparation failure or stale resource identity
Less than 250 MiB free before TTS
Less than 150 MiB free before render
Any job/stage status already claimed or terminal
acceptance: Machine QA and exact MP4 availability are required. HUMAN PASS remains false until the user reviews the exact MP4.

source_patch.execution: one-shot container with isolated source bind mounts; no service restart or image build
